title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Dispute Cases Related to Enterprises Transferred or Dissolved by the Military, Armed Police, and Political-Legal Organs, and Enterprises Separated from Party and Government Organs

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where an enterprise established by the armed forces, armed police forces, political and legal organs, and Party and government organs (hereinafter referred to as the 'established enterprise') meets the legal person conditions and has obtained an enterprise legal person business license, it shall, in accordance with Article 60 of the Civil Code, independently bear civil liability with all of its property.

Article 2 Where an established enterprise has obtained an enterprise legal person business license, and the funds actually invested by it do not match the registered capital but have reached the amount specified in Item 7 of Article 12 of the Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Registration of Enterprise Legal Persons, it shall be deemed to have legal person status, and the establishing unit shall bear civil liability within the scope of the difference between the funds actually invested and the registered capital of the enterprise.

Article 3 Where an established enterprise has obtained an enterprise legal person business license, but the funds invested have not reached the amount specified in Item 7 of Article 12 of the Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Registration of Enterprise Legal Persons, or it does not meet the other conditions for being an enterprise legal person, it shall be deemed not to have legal person status, and its civil liability shall be borne by the establishing unit.

Article 4 Where an establishing unit withdraws, transfers funds or conceals property to evade the debts of the established enterprise, it shall return the withdrawn or transferred funds or the concealed property to satisfy the debts of the established enterprise.

Article 5 Where an establishing unit or its competent department, at the time of the cancellation of the established enterprise, issues a certification document to the administrative authority for industry and commerce, voluntarily undertaking responsibility for the debts of the established enterprise, it shall bear civil liability for the debts of the established enterprise in accordance with the acceptance.

Article 6 Where an establishing unit has already borne civil liability within the scope of the insufficiency of the registered capital of the established enterprise, the registered capital of the establishing unit shall be deemed to have been fully paid in, and it shall no longer bear liability for insufficiency of registered capital.
II. Handling of Bankruptcy Cases of Transferred, Cancelled, or Disconnected Enterprises

Article 7 Where an established enterprise or its creditor applies to the People's Court for bankruptcy, regardless of whether the registered capital of the establishing unit has been fully paid in, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 8 Where an established enterprise is declared bankrupt, the liquidation group shall be responsible for recovering from the establishing unit the registered capital not fully contributed, the funds and physical objects collected, the funds transferred, or the property concealed.

Article 9 Where an established enterprise has raised funds from the public or from its internal employees that have not been repaid, at the time of distribution of bankruptcy property, such debts shall be satisfied in accordance with Item 1 of Paragraph 1 of Article 113 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China.
III. Property Preservation and Enforcement

Article 10 Where the People's Court, when trying a case concerning an enterprise that has been transferred, cancelled, or disconnected, determines that the establishing unit shall bear civil liability, it shall not take preservation and enforcement measures such as sealing up, seizing, freezing, or auctioning the State Treasury funds, military funds, fiscal appropriation accounts, office buildings, vehicles, or other necessary office supplies of the establishing unit.
IV. Scope of Application

Article 11 These Provisions shall apply only to the trial of debt dispute cases and bankruptcy cases arising from the enterprises transferred or cancelled by the armed forces, armed police forces, and political and legal organs, and the enterprises disconnected from Party and government organs, on this occasion.
